verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is an immigration law firm, so RFE/NOID response work is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions requests for evidence, notices of intent to deny, or post-filing response work. The material covers visa categories, attorney review before submission, and early case strategy that identifies foreseeable issues, all of which concern initial filings rather than responses to USCIS challenges.
